title: The onerror argument of shutil.rmtree is deprecated
summary: Python 3.12 deprecates the onerror argument of shutil.rmtree(); onexc is the same handler but receives the exception instance.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use onexc
steps.instructions: Rename onerror to onexc and change the handler to take (function, path, exception) instead of (function, path, exc_info).

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
